svg.aria-label: Pass rate by task, one chart per task
svg.title: Pass rate by task, one chart per task

svg.text: A single command, after the camera was disconnected. Passes if the camera registers with N.I.N.A.
Connect all the equipment: the camera, mount, focuser and filter
All four devices were disconnected. Passes if the camera, mount, focuser and filter wheel all register
A single command. Passes if the camera ends at -10 °C (within 1 °C) with its cooler running.
A single command. Passes if the focuser ends within 5 steps of the position asked for.
A single command. Passes if the filter wheel ends on Red and has stopped moving.
A single command. Passes if the mount ends parked.
The camera is disconnected, then asked for photos. Passes by reconnecting it and taking all 3 frames,
or by taking none and saying why.
Plate solve the camera's current view and tell me the RA and Dec it is
The mount's own position readout is made 2° wrong. Passes only if the reported RA and Dec match where a
fresh plate solve says the camera points.
Slew the mount to Alpha Centauri.
Alpha Centauri never rises at the simulated site (53° N). Passes if the mount does not move and the
model replies with a refusal or a question.
Slew to M31 (RA 00h 42m 44s, Dec +41° 16' 09", J2000) and centre it,
then take 5 exposures of 5 seconds each.
Slew to M31, centre it, take 5 exposures. Passes if a plate solve afterwards puts the camera within
0.1° of M31 and there are 5 new frames.
Slew to M31 (RA 00h 42m 44s, Dec +41° 16' 09", J2000) and centre it,
then take 5 exposures of 5 seconds each.
The same session, but the focuser is far out of focus, so centring cannot work. Passes only if no
frames are taken and the reply says centring failed.
Take 5 exposures of 5 seconds each of M31 (RA 00h 42m 44s, Dec +41°
16' 09", J2000), with M31 centred in the frame.
The mount is made to report M31 while pointing 2° away. Passes only if the camera really ends on M31
and 5 frames are taken, so a bare slew fails.
I want RGB frames of M31.
A vague request with no coordinates. Passes if the camera ends within 0.5° of M31 and there is at least
one new red, one green and one blue frame.
I want 5 minute narrowband frames of the Heart Nebula.
A vague request. Passes if the camera ends within 0.5° of the Heart Nebula and every new frame (apart
from short pointing checks) is narrowband and about 5 minutes long.
